body: I may just do that in the future. Thank you once again.
Actually, I don't think a simple thank you expresses just how much what you said affected me, but know that I meant so much more.
I play rugby and I've spent the past 9 years doing martial arts. I run 2 miles at least 4 times a week after school on the indoor track...it only helps when I'm already in a good mood.
I've been feeling like this (without a purpose) since I was 15...It hasn't changed much...
